pr_title: Remove bundles when deduplicating entry assets that are referenced by their descendants
pr_body:
Closes #5181

This fixes an issue where a bundle would not be properly removed if its entry asset was referenced by a descendant asset that was deduplicated. Because we only checked if the root of the asset graph to be removed was the entry [0], the untyped edge would not be removed even though the contains edge was.

This also updates an assertion that runs after removing a bundle group to only happen if `removeBundleGroup` was not re-entered: it's possible for `removeBundleGroup` to remove bundles if they only belonged to that group, and for `removeBundle` to call `removeBundleGroup` if it leaves the bundle group entry. This is covered by the same test case.

This also fixes an oversight in `removeAssetGraph` where a reference edge was _added_ between a bundle and a dependency if it already existed, rather than removing it.

Test Plan: Added integration test

[0] https://github.com/parcel-bundler/parcel/blob/806cc65e0e430b1120cdcf1676e2f58738326d30/packages/core/core/src/BundleGraph.js#L408-L410
